cim_eredeti: Glean on privacy and OpenAI Private Intelligence
szoveg_eredeti:
Using more capable AI starts with confidence that your data stays under your control. For Glean’s customers, privacy is a priority.

Glean co-founder and CTO Vishwanath T R shares how Glean and OpenAI have worked together to help meet those needs, including through the Private Safety Processing preview.

Learn more about OpenAI Private Intelligence: https://openai.com/business/private-intelligence/
